test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Why was English-medium education significant during colonial rule?

options.text: It acted as a tool of cultural control

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. It acted as a tool of cultural control**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **“tool of cultural control”** refers to a method or mechanism used to shape, influence, or dominate the beliefs and behaviors of a group. (सांस्कृतिक नियंत्रण का साधन)

 
 
• **Example:** English-medium education was used as a tool of cultural control, aligning a section of Indians with colonial values and distancing them from traditional knowledge.
 
 
 
• In the passage, English education was promoted as a marker of intellect and administrative suitability, reinforcing social hierarchies and embedding colonial authority.
 
• Thus, English-medium education played a significant role in consolidating colonial power through cultural influence rather than mere force.

Therefore, the correct answer is- It acted as a tool of cultural control

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **It unified all Indian languages** (इसने सभी भारतीय भाषाओं को एकजुट किया): Suggests bringing all regional languages together as one.

 
 
• **Example:** There is no evidence in the passage that English-medium education unified Indian languages.
 
 
 
• **It preserved oral traditions** (इसने मौखिक परंपराओं को संरक्षित किया): Means to maintain and protect traditional spoken forms of knowledge.
 
 
• **Example:** The passage states that regional languages lost their oral richness, so English-medium education did not preserve oral traditions.
 
 
 
• **It reduced social divisions** (इसने सामाजिक विभाजनों को कम किया): Means to lessen or remove differences between social groups.
 
 
• **Example:** The passage clearly states that linguistic restructuring deepened, not reduced, social divisions.
 
 

41:T6fa,
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.
